P17-12.name: Ophanimon Falldown Mode
P17-12.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple/Yellow & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
By returning a pre-advent card beneath this Spirit without [Advent] to the Hand, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attack)
By destroying an opposing exhausted spirit, put a core from the Void to your Life.

CB03-P17.name: Raguelmon
CB03-P17.effect:
Flash - [Advent: [[Ultimate (Family)] (Ultimate]], (Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core](Soul Core) to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy every opposing Nexus. For each Nexus destroyed by this effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

CB03-CP01.name: Zubamon
CB03-CP01.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more]

[LV1] [Digivolve: All] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a "Champion" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved]
When the braved Spirit activates [Super Digivolution], this Brave enters refreshed condition, and can brave to the summoned Spirit.
